reserveReview.rationale: Current issuer documentation identifies tracked hbUSDT 0x5e105266db42f78fa814322bce7f388b4c2e61eb as its automated USDT strategy vault and describes instant and two-day classic exits. The previously pinned deposit-token review at HyperEVM block 40439370 identified USDT0, not direct USDT; USDT0's current deployment registry confirms HyperEVM token 0xb8ce59fc3717ada4c02eadf9682a9e934f625ebb. A fresh asset() probe on the depositor 0x6261f30144b259c74243d5f5d9230941186ac936 reverted at block 47265526 and does not supersede that deposit-token identity. The reserve row expresses the retained whole strategy-vault claim under D3, with an unverified USDT0 intermediary annotation; it does not quantify idle USDT0 or any constituent allocation. Canonical escrow coverage and current venue/position weights remain unreconciled.
